instrument: Salem City Council data center moratorium
summary: The Council unanimously initiated a temporary moratorium process on new data center applications on August 3 2026; the City Attorney said the pause would need at least 120 days and could extend to six months. A final hearing was held September 21 2026; reporting ahead of it described a pause to January 19 2027.
notes: Verrus (Oakline at Mill Creek, $5.1B, 75 acres) filed before the vote; its application remains under current code. Governor Kotek ordered the state land sale for the project withdrawn. Update status once the September 21 outcome is confirmed.
confidence_note: Relayed; ordinance not read and final vote not confirmed at retrieval.

source.citation: KATU; Salem Reporter via Let's Data Science; OPB Think Out Loud
